rows.answer: Frozen direct-cycle plus collective V2 model: primary Recall=0.4, native F1=0.9230769230769231. SCC/cycle proof and the collective Ca/Ce/coupling/I/betweenness/PageRank feature mechanism were preserved. No final per-feature selection or ranking was performed.

rows.limitations: Benchmark-specific human semantic truth; classification quality and transport availability are distinct.
